test_unary_operator: test the VariationTest class to verify unary negation operator works on deterministic Constant variations
test_binary_operator: test the VariationTest class to verify binary operators like add, sub, mul, truediv, floordiv, and pow on variations
test_binary_operator_str: test the VariationTest class to verify string and repr representation of binary operations on variations
test_getitem: test the VariationTest class to verify indexing operations on numpy array variations with deterministic Constant
run_variation_tests: run the absltest main to execute all variation operation tests for unary, binary, and getitem operations
